text:
This looks like a maraging steel, roughly 18Ni with Co 8, Mo 5 and Ti 1.5. That is close to a C300 or C350 type grade, or an experimental one. Ti 1.5 with Mo 5 and Co 7.9 suggests a very high strength grade, around 2000 MPa or more. The Matbench steels dataset has yield strengths for maraging steels in the range of about 1700 to 2500 MPa. I'm estimating from the grade, not looking up the recorded row, so this is my best guess at 2050 MPa.
